name: Uninstall
product: FortiClient Uninstaller by Fortinet

evidence.says: Fortinet documents FortiClientUninstaller as the FortiClient removal utility, and a reply identifies the FortiClientUninstaller.app bundle and its Uninstall executable.

notes: The scan filename and alias identify FortiClientUninstaller.app despite the generic bundle ID.

name: Octave-6.2.0
product: Octave.app, the Octave.app project's macOS distribution of GNU Octave

evidence.says: The maintainers list version 9.2 as the current release, with a separate Apple Silicon DMG and Intel DMG, and trace the distribution back to the listed 6.2.0 release.
The official 9.2 distribution tag identifies the bundled GNU Octave as 9.2.0.

notes: The 6.2.0 suffix in the listing name is the old scan version. The project documents special installation steps for its unsigned distribution.

name: Uninstall VIDBOX Capture Device Driver
product: VIDBOX Capture Device Driver uninstaller by VIDBOX

evidence.says: The VIDBOX Capture & Stream Mac guide shows the driver uninstaller separately from the Capture & Stream and Audio Utility apps.
VIDBOX distributes capture-device drivers by USB device model and macOS version.

notes: The scanned bundle is an AppleScript uninstaller for the capture device driver.

name: Disk Inventory X
product: Disk Inventory X by Tjark Derlien

evidence.says: The original developer says he will not resume development and points to community forks while keeping the original 1.3 download online.
Official release notes date stable version 1.3 to December 8, 2019, and say it is unsigned and unnotarized.
Homebrew identifies the original 1.3 release as Intel-only and requiring Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The architecture finding covers the final stable release. An unreleased 1.4 beta and community forks fall outside this result.
notes: Disk Inventory Xs and other maintained forks have their own builds.

name: CleanMyDrive 2
product: CleanMyDrive 2 by MacPaw

evidence.says: MacPaw confirms it stopped maintaining the standalone app in October 2023, removed its App Store listing, and lists Intel and Apple Silicon among the requirements for existing installations.
MacPaw announced the app's retirement and moved its functionality into CleanMyMac's Connected Devices.

limitation: MacPaw documents Apple Silicon compatibility for existing copies but does not specify a final version or whether it was native.

name: V2RayX
product: V2RayX by Cenmrev

evidence.says: The upstream project's final v1.5.1 release provides V2RayX.app.zip, whose V2RayX.app/Contents/MacOS/V2RayX executable inspected as x86_64 only and whose plist matches the listed bundle ID.
GitHub marks the repository as archived by its owner on January 12, 2024 and marks v1.5.1 as latest.
The live release API gives February 14, 2019 as the v1.5.1 publication date.

limitation: Runtime behavior under Rosetta was not tested.
notes: The upstream binary was Intel-only and remains downloadable from the archived project.

name: Teamflow
product: Teamflow virtual office for Mac by Crivello Corp. (formerly Huddle)

evidence.says: The vendor's current Mac download links to a universal DMG on Teamflow's Huddle production distribution host.
The official update manifest lists separate arm64, x64 and universal packages for Teamflow 69.0.0 and gives its release date as December 5, 2022.
The vendor identifies the operator as Crivello Corp., doing business as Crivello Technologies Corp.

name: Kiwi for Gmail
product: Kiwi for Gmail by Zive

evidence.says: The vendor offers the current macOS edition from its downloads host.
The vendor's update manifest names both universal Mac artifacts for 5.0.2 and gives a release date of November 17, 2026.
Homebrew's live cask API identifies the bundle family as com.zive.kiwi and points to Kiwi for Gmail 5.0.2's vendor-hosted universal ZIP.

name: SDFormatter
product: SD Memory Card Formatter by the SD Association, developed by Tuxera

evidence.says: The SD Association identifies the current macOS formatter as version 5.0.4 and retains a note about a possible Rosetta prompt.
The official version 5.0.4 package contains SD Card Formatter.app/Contents/MacOS/SD Card Formatter with arm64, x86_64, i386 and ppc_7400 Mach-O slices.

notes: The 4.00 scan used jp.co.trendy.sdformatter. The current SD Association release uses com.tuxera.SDCardFormatter and reports short build string 5.0.4-c3c2efc. The architecture finding applies to the currently served package.

name: LibreELEC
product: LibreELEC USB-SD Creator by the LibreELEC project

evidence.says: The project's historical issue ties the scanned AppleScript bundle ID to LibreELEC USB-SD Creator.
LibreELEC published version 1.6 on November 18, 2026 with an official macOS DMG.
The version 1.6 DMG contains LibreELEC USB-SD Creator.app/Contents/MacOS/LibreELEC USB-SD Creator with x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices.

notes: Rename the listing to LibreELEC USB-SD Creator. The current build uses tv.libreelec.usb-sd-creator.

name: GoTiengViet
product: GoTiengViet Vietnamese input utility by Tran Ky Nam Software

evidence.says: The Vietnamese-language vendor page offers GoTiengViet 2.4 for macOS with a June 3, 2023 date.
The official DMG contains GoTiengViet.app/Contents/MacOS/GoTiengViet 2.4 with x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices and a matching bundle ID.

name: JetDriveToolbox
product: JetDrive Toolbox by Transcend Information, Inc.

evidence.says: Transcend identifies the Mac software, lists 4.5 as its current release and gives macOS 10.15 as its minimum.
The official 4.5 installer contains separate ToolboxM1.pkg and ToolboxIntel.pkg payloads, whose respective Contents/MacOS/JetDriveToolbox binaries inspected as arm64 and x86_64.

notes: Both 4.5 payloads report com.transcend.JetDriveToolbox-v2, a changed bundle ID for the same vendor product.

name: Archive Utility
product: Archive Utility bundled with macOS by Apple

evidence.says: Apple documents its built-in ZIP compression and extraction on macOS.
A first-hand inspection of the Apple-signed Archive Utility in macOS reports version 10.15 build 178 and an arm64e main executable.

limitation: The architecture comes from a published first-hand binary inspection. An exact release day was not established.
notes: Archive Utility is shipped with macOS, and version 10.15 is the app version rather than the macOS version.

name: Adapter
product: Adapter by Macroplant

evidence.says: Macroplant lists Adapter 2.1.6 as its latest macOS release.
The official Adapter 2.1.6 disk image contained Adapter.app/Contents/MacOS/Adapter, whose Mach-O header was x86_64 only.

limitation: No verified Rosetta 2 launch or conversion test for this build was found.

name: RECentral Express
product: RECentral Express for macOS by AVerMedia

evidence.says: AVerMedia's end-of-service page dates the last listed RECentral Express build 1.2.92 to October 17, 2024 and names August 31, 2026 as the end of security update support.

limitation: The processor architecture of the final build is unverified, and its official download exceeds the binary-inspection size limit.
notes: AVerMedia continues to host the final installer on its end-of-service download page.

name: Diagram Weaver
product: Diagram Weaver by Zhang Guangjian

evidence.says: Apple's live lookup returns zero results for the former China storefront item.
The historical scan identifies com.zhangguangjian.graph version 1.0.4 build 11 and records an x86_64 executable.

limitation: The former Mac App Store page no longer resolves, and current official distribution and architecture could not be established.
notes: The historical 1.0.4 scan is Intel-only. Its Rosetta 2 behavior is unverified.

product: 1440 Minutes Left Today by Krzysztof Zbudniewek

evidence.says: The Mac App Store lists Krzysztof Zbudniewek's 1440 Minutes Left Today 1.4, released October 29, 2019.
The historical scan for the same bundle ID shows short version 1.4, build 11, and a single 64-bit Intel executable architecture.

limitation: The App Store lists the same version but does not expose the build number or architecture, and Rosetta 2 runtime behavior is unverified.
notes: The source scanner labels the release 1.40, while its Info.plist and the App Store use 1.4.

name: Pliim
product: Pliim by Zeh Fernandes

evidence.says: The official v1.7.0 release asset Pliim.app.zip contained an x86_64-only main executable at Pliim.app/Contents/MacOS/Pliim.
Homebrew marks its Pliim 1.7.0 cask disabled and identifies Rosetta 2 as required on Apple Silicon.

limitation: A Rosetta 2 prerequisite is documented, but a successful launch of this build on Apple Silicon is unverified.
notes: PliimPRO is a separate rewrite from the same developer.

name: PlayOff
product: PlayOff for macOS by Martin Jr Powlette

evidence.says: Contemporaneous hands-on coverage identifies Martin Powlette's Apple Music playback handoff utility and links its separate Mac App Store listing at ID 1454620165.
Apple's storefront API returns zero results for the original Mac App Store product ID.
Apple's lookup for the exact scanned macOS bundle ID returns zero results.

limitation: The final Mac version and architecture were not established. The retirement date is unknown.
notes: This was a separately distributed Mac app. The similarly named iOS listing used a different bundle and storefront ID.

name: Pluto TV
product: Pluto TV for Mac (Mac Catalyst) by Pluto Inc.

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies the genuine tv.pluto.mac desktop bundle at 4.8.3 and records an Intel executable.
Pluto's current distribution guide lists Microsoft Store for its desktop download and a browser option for desktop viewing.
Apple's U.S. storefront lookup returns zero results for the original Mac bundle ID.

limitation: The final macOS release and architecture are unverified. The old scan proves only that 4.8.3 was Intel.
notes: The Pluto TV service and its other platform apps remain active.

name: DeskApp for YouTube
product: DeskApp for YouTube by Rocky Sand Studio Ltd.

evidence.says: The archived product listing identifies Rocky Sand Studio's YouTube Mac client and the original Mac App Store listing at ID 1180531112.
Apple's storefront API returns zero results for the original app record.
Apple's lookup for the exact scanned bundle ID returns zero results.

limitation: The final version and architecture were not established. The retirement date is unknown.

name: LensSystemSoftwareUpdater
product: Sony Lens System Software Updater bundled with individual lens firmware updates

evidence.says: Sony supplies LensSystemSoftwareUpdater inside the SELP16502 lens firmware update disk image and documents it as part of that model-specific procedure.

notes: This is a firmware updater bundle used in lens-specific downloads. Sony publishes the downloads by hardware model and firmware version.

name: Codespace
product: Codespace snippet manager by Tristan Edwards

evidence.says: The developer's release history lists 1.6.1 as the latest named release and dates it July 24, 2021.
The official Codespace-1.6.1.dmg contained Codespace.app/Contents/MacOS/Codespace, whose Mach-O header showed x86_64 only and whose bundle ID matched the listing.

limitation: No verified Rosetta 2 launch of this version was found.

name: Timeular
product: EARLY time tracker, formerly Timeular, by Timeular GmbH

evidence.says: The vendor still links to separate Apple Silicon and Intel desktop installers for EARLY.

The current Apple Silicon disk image contains EARLY.app/Contents/MacOS/EARLY with a thin arm64 Mach-O header and Info.plist version 6.9.5-m1, build 6.9.5-m1.99415, under the original com.timeular.zei bundle ID.
The vendor's Mac update manifest dates the 6.9.5 release to June 23, 2025.

notes: Timeular was renamed EARLY, and the download site now identifies EARLY as part of TimeTac.

name: Encrypto
product: Encrypto by MacPaw Way Ltd

evidence.says: MacPaw lists macOS version 1.4.3 as current and dates it August 14, 2024.
MacPaw's App Store version history records the introduction of native arm64 and confirms 1.4.3 as the current build.
The catalog specifically lists Apple Silicon and Intel architectures for Encrypto 1.4.3.

name: CareConnect
product: CareConnect macOS client (Corilus is a likely vendor; edition unverified)

evidence.says: The original 5.0.205 plist identifies a JavaApplicationStub and generic Install4j product ID without naming the vendor or edition.
Corilus documents an Arm installer for its General Practitioner edition.
Corilus also documents a Physiotherapist Mac client whose installed application is named CareConnect.
The vendor's Specialist support also documents a Mac workflow within CareConnect.

limitation: The exact scanned Install4j bundle ID could not be tied to a current vendor edition with known architecture.

name: Image Lab
product: Bio-Rad Image Lab desktop software, Standard Edition

evidence.says: Bio-Rad lists Image Lab Software for Mac Version 6.1 as a download.
The Image Lab 6.1 user guide gives Intel Core i3 or equivalent as a minimum and documents installation of the Standard Edition on macOS.

limitation: The baseline processor requirement does not identify the Mac executable architecture, the installer could not be inspected, and Apple Silicon operation is unverified.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 3
product: The Jackbox Party Pack 3 by Jackbox Games

evidence.says: Jackbox Games distributes Party Pack 3 for desktop through Steam.
Steam depot metadata lists public build 15536655, deployed October 14, 2024, and a macOS depot.
WorksOnMac reports the Steam Mac build is Intel and runs under Rosetta 2 based on Steam build data.
A player reports running Party Pack 3 on a MacBook Neo and notes an issue with percentage inputs.

limitation: The Steam Mac executable was not inspected locally. The Mac App Store edition was not verified.
notes: The current Steam Mac download exceeds the audit's binary inspection size limit.

name: VanSpace3DBETA
product: vanspace3D V2 beta desktop application by vanspace

evidence.says: The vendor's earlier download instructions had moved desktop customers to V3 for Mac and PC.
The vendor identifies browser-based V4 as the current release and offers desktop V3.08 as the legacy re-download.

limitation: The final V2 beta version and its architecture could not be verified.
notes: The input was a V2.09 beta. Existing V3 customers still have a separate legacy desktop download as of the audit date.

name: All-in-One Messenger
product: All-in-One Messenger by Henrik Wenz (allinone.im)

evidence.says: The publisher offers the macOS disk image All-in-One Messenger-2.5.0.dmg as its latest release.
The official disk image's All-in-One Messenger.app/Contents/MacOS/All-in-One Messenger was x86_64 only and matched bundle ID im.allinone.messenger.
Homebrew identifies the same 2.5.0 release as Intel and lists Rosetta 2 as a requirement on Apple Silicon.

limitation: The Rosetta 2 prerequisite is documented, but a successful launch of this build on Apple Silicon is unverified.

name: Jiggler
product: Jiggler by Stick Software

evidence.says: The developer's tagged release lists Jiggler 1.10 and was published December 9, 2025.
The vendor's current Jiggler.dmg contains Jiggler.app/Contents/MacOS/Jiggler, a universal Mach-O with x86_64 and arm64 slices, with matching bundle ID and version 1.10.

name: LittleIpsum
product: LittleIpsum by Dustin Senos (Small Animal Studios)

evidence.says: Dustin Senos lists LittleIpsum among his own projects and links to its former Mac App Store item 405772121.
Apple's live lookup returns zero results for the app ID in the Canadian storefront linked by the developer.
The former product domain now serves an unrelated general Apple news site and has no official LittleIpsum download.
The archived scan metadata identifies Dustin Senos's version 2.0.6 build as Intel-only.

limitation: Apple Silicon runtime behavior for the final known Intel-only version is unverified.

name: Knotes
product: Knotes Kindle reading-notes manager by Yizhao He

evidence.says: The developer's change log lists Knotes 2.11.2 dated October 14, 2021 and links the app family to the earlier 1.3.0 release.
Apple's live US storefront lookup returns no results for the former Knotes Mac App Store item.
The original developer domain now returns a landing-page redirect instead of the Knotes product page.
The historical scan identifies the exact bundle ID and version 1.3.0.

limitation: No current official desktop binary or architecture statement was located for 2.11.2, and the maintenance status is unclear.

name: Origami Studio
product: Origami Studio by Meta Platforms (Facebook)

evidence.says: Meta identifies version 233 dated November 19, 2026 as the latest release and documents Apple M1 support in the older version 85.
Desktop Insights reports a first-hand universal binary scan of Meta's Origami Studio version 215.0 with Intel and Apple Silicon architectures.

limitation: Evidence identifies a previous universal build, but no architecture evidence specific to the current release 233 was found and its disk image exceeds 150 MB.

name: XiYou
product: XiYou desktop client, vendor unconfirmed

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies com.xiyou.desktop 2.9.5 and the XiYou executable.
A site using the XiYou VPN name advertises a Mac client, but its page supplies no bundle ID linking it to the scanned app.
A separate site using the XiYou name links its M-series Mac download to a Clash Verge-branded disk image.

limitation: No live source tied the exact bundle ID to a current vendor or official build.

name: Heredis 2021
product: Heredis 2021 genealogy software for Mac by Heredis (BSD Concept)

evidence.says: Heredis still links to a dedicated Heredis 2021 installer for macOS.
The vendor lists Heredis 2021 compatibility by operating system without specifying the executable architecture.

limitation: The official Mac DMG is about 465 MB, above the audit inspection limit, and no exact architecture or Rosetta claim was found.
notes: This record covers the 2021 edition. The vendor offers later annual editions separately.

name: Quiver
product: Quiver by Yaogang Lian Software, formerly HappenApps

evidence.says: The developer still offers the direct Quiver trial and links to the Mac App Store edition.
The official trial archive contains Quiver.app/Contents/MacOS/Quiver version 3.3 with x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices and the original bundle ID.
The developer's Mac App Store release history dates the Apple Silicon update to 3.3 and lists a newer 3.3.1 point release.

notes: The current developer-hosted download is 3.3. The store's separately delivered 3.3.1 point release was not inspected.

name: Shrew Soft VPN Access Manager
product: Shrew Soft VPN Client for Mac OS X, VPN Access Manager GUI

evidence.says: Shrew Soft's last release announcements are from 2013 and identify OS X support as preliminary.
The current vendor catalog lists Windows and Linux/BSD downloads without a maintained Mac distribution.
The remaining Mac installer contains Shrew Soft VPN Access Manager.app/Contents/MacOS/Shrew Soft VPN Access Manager 2.2.0, an i386-only Mach-O with the scanned bundle ID.

limitation: The architecture of the scanned 2.2.1 build and whether it was the final Mac build were not established.
notes: The directly inspected vendor-hosted Mac package is 2.2.0. The batch contains a later 2.2.1 historical scan.

name: MarginNote 2 Pro
product: MarginNote 2 Pro for Mac by Beijing Yunsi Software Technology

evidence.says: The historical Mac App Store catalog identifies Beijing Yunsi's MarginNote Mac product, version 2.7.23, and its Pro purchase option.
Apple's US storefront lookup returns zero results for the former MarginNote 2 Mac product ID.
The historical scan identifies MarginNote 2 Pro 2.7.23 build 2.7.23005 and records an x86_64 executable for QReader.MarginNoteMac.
The vendor's current downloads advertise MarginNote 5 and later-generation purchase and upgrade paths.

limitation: The last documented version is Intel-only. The final release date and any later direct-distribution build are unverified.
notes: The separately distributed MarginNote XE uses a different bundle ID.

name: SamyangLensManager
product: Samyang Lens Manager for Lens Station by LK Samyang

evidence.says: LK Samyang lists current Mac V2.78 dated November 9, 2026, and the linked SamyangLensManager_MAC_V2.78.zip contains SamyangLensManager.app/Contents/MacOS/SamyangLensManager with x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices.
An earlier Samyang notice identifies Lens Manager as the Mac and Windows software used with Lens Station for lens firmware updates.

notes: The current Mac application uses com.lksamyang.SamyangLensmanager and reports a short version of 2.7.8 and build 52. The vendor labels that download V2.78.
